appearances.candidateText: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.
LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;
The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;
Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.
you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.
Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.
Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp.
the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.
Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.
the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;
The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.
Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,
Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.
The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.
Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,
Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,
As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.
The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.
The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.
The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;
The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.

The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.

Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp.
the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;
The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
